# CANDIDATE: VIX_MEAN_REVERT_PUSH

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sharp intraday drop in VIX signals fading fear; buying SPY on a VWAP pullback with bullish candle alignment captures the ensuing mean‑revertive bounce. The edge exists because VIX mean-reversion often precedes short-term SPY relief rallies when fear exhausts, and combining it with VWAP support and engulfing candle confirmation filters for high-probability mean-reversion entries.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If VIX falls > 1.5 points from its prior close and SPY price is above VWAP and EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55, then enter long on the first 5‑min bullish engulfing candle that closes at or above VWAP. Exit shape: Stop at the low of the engulfing candle; primary target at 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, switch to a chandelier trail (ATR(3) * 2.5). Regime hint: Best when VIX > 20 at the start of the drop and time is 10:00‑14:30; avoid if VIX remains flat or rises.
